02 / THE PERSON BEHIND THE PROJECTS

Curiosity.
Practice.
Progress.

AM

BUILDING FROM
KARACHI, PAKISTAN

I’m a full-stack developer and Computer Science student based in Karachi. I build web applications with MERN and Python/Flask, and cross-platform mobile applications with Flutter/Firebase. I recently completed Aptech’s ADSE program and I’m continuing my Intermediate studies at Commecs College.

My workflow combines AI-assisted development tools with hands-on implementation, debugging, testing and deployment. I focus on how interfaces, APIs, authentication and data fit together, and I keep improving my projects as I learn. Each case study explains the application, its current release and the next improvements.
